summary: Siemens CEO Roland Busch describes an on-stage moment with Jensen Huang and Benioff, announcing scaled agentic AI collaboration across industries with NVIDIA and Salesforce.
NVIDIA recaps Jensen Huang's Dreamforce conversation with Marc Benioff on open models and agentic enterprise, noting Salesforce introduced Koa, its CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron.
Salesforce highlights Anthropic's Dreamforce demo showing Claude querying Salesforce data, building command centers, and sharing artifacts in Slack/Teams via 37+ pre-built Sales skills.
Salesforce's company page announces that Dreamforce is one week away.
Salesforce announces Jensen Huang joining the Dreamforce Main Keynote at 10 a.m. PT, streamed free on Salesforce+.
Salesforce announces a Dreamforce conversation between Sam Altman and Marc Benioff on AI, ChatGPT, and the OpenAI-Salesforce partnership, streaming free on Salesforce+.
Salesforce promotes a Dreamforce session where Dario Amodei and Marc Benioff discuss the Claudeforce partnership between Anthropic and Salesforce, streamed live on Salesforce+.
Informatica announces its debut appearance at Dreamforce as part of the Salesforce family.
Pascal Bornet, describing himself as sponsored, says Benioff's Headless 360 announcement shifts value from interface ownership to underlying enterprise data, rules and context.
Salesforce announces actor Jeremy Renner will speak at Dreamforce about his recovery and his RennerVation Foundation supporting foster care and at-risk youth, streamed on Salesforce+.
Salesforce's company page promotes a 3-minute recap video of Marc Benioff's Dreamforce keynote branded 'Hey AI, meet the #1 CRM.'
Pascal Bornet, in a sponsored post, recounts a Dreamforce conversation with Adam Forrest, Maurice Ashley and Sam Shankland comparing chess judgment to agentic AI decision-making in enterprises.
Marc Benioff announces the Salesforce Trusted Enterprise AI Harness, built on six capabilities spanning context, agency, action, governance, security, and models, unveiled at Dreamforce.
Salesforce highlights Marc Benioff's #DF26 conversation with Siemens CEO Roland Busch demonstrating the Agentic Enterprise, streamed live on Salesforce+.
Salesforce's company page shares a photo recap, calling it "the Dreamforce Day 1 camera roll."
Salesforce announces Marc Benioff's Main Keynote at 10 a.m. PT, livestreamed on LinkedIn.
Salesforce welcomes "Fin" to its first Dreamforce as part of the Salesforce Ohana.
Alyson Weinstein announces becoming EVP & Global CRO of Data360 and Tableau at Salesforce, thanking colleagues, and says she's counting down to Dreamforce next week.
Salesforce announces a live Jensen Huang and Marc Benioff conversation at Dreamforce, following the debut of Koa, its CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron.
Salesforce promotes a live Dreamforce Main Keynote stream where Marc Benioff shows how to "unlock trapped value from anywhere" as the #1 CRM.
Slack introduces Slackforce Surfaces, letting Slackbot generate live dashboards and reports from Salesforce data inside Slack, showcased at Dreamforce.
Tableau invites attendees to its DF26 keynote on agentic analytics, featuring Mark Recher, Southard Jones, and speakers from Mastercard, CrowdStrike, and IBM.
Salesforce President and CMO Erin Oles says Dreamforce showcases the "Agentic Enterprise" through customers, partners and Trailblazers, spanning Slack, Claude and Lightning after 27 years.
Anton Osika says he flew to San Francisco for Dreamforce to argue that Lovable has moved beyond "vibes."
Siemens CEO Roland Busch announces connecting Siemens Teamcenter with Salesforce Agentforce, thanking Marc Benioff for hosting him at the opening keynote.
Salesforce's Rohan Kumar announces Koa, a CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron, post-trained on synthetic data, running inside Salesforce's trust boundary without customer data.
Salesforce honors Steve Molis with the Golden Hoodie at the Dreamforce 2026 Main Keynote, citing 10x MVP status and 122K+ community questions answered.
Dr. Joerg Storm reports Marc Benioff told him Germany's Mittelstand is a fast Agentforce and Data 360 adopter, citing 50,000 attendees and speakers Jensen Huang, Dario Amodei and Sam Altman.
Trailblazer Community congratulates Steve Molis on receiving a Golden Hoodie at the DF26 Main Keynote for over 20 years of community contributions.
Pascal Bornet's Agentic Intelligence newsletter lists Dreamforce's Salesforce news among five AI-agent developments, including OpenAI's sponsored ChatGPT agents and identity-based security.
AIM reports Salesforce and NVIDIA launched Koa, a CRM reasoning model built on Nemotron 3 Super, piloting with Formula 1, Xero, and UChicago Medicine.
Google Cloud announces expanded Salesforce partnership at Dreamforce, running Salesforce on Google Cloud and linking its headless architecture with Gemini Enterprise for shared-data agents.

Advisor Helen Yu, in a sponsored post, details Benioff's Dreamforce keynote with Dario Amodei and Jensen Huang, covering AIforce, Siemens' SAP agent demo, and governance features like zero data retention.
Tableau announces it is bringing agentic analytics to Dreamforce.
Emma Shad, Emellex CEO, publishes a LinkedIn Today analysis of Dreamforce covering Agentforce, AIforce, Slack, and Salesforce's partnerships with NVIDIA, Anthropic, Google Cloud, AWS, and OpenAI.
Mario de Felipe questions Salesforce's keynote demo of agent "Marshall" impersonating a user across 51 SAP S/4HANA transactions, citing SAP's API policy restrictions on impersonation.
Deloitte's Harry Datwani promotes expanded Claudeforce collaboration among Salesforce, Anthropic and Deloitte Digital, inviting attendees to the Deloitte Digital House at Dreamforce.
Salesforce News & Insights quotes Marc Benioff describing AIforce as a dynamic interface and Jensen Huang urging companies to engage AI, linking to a keynote recap video.
Emellex CEO Emma Shad describes AIforce as an enterprise AI harness and details Koa, Salesforce's NVIDIA-built CRM reasoning model trained on synthetic data across 14 industries.
Ghanshyam Upadhyay reports a global Salesforce outage (incident 20004433) during Dreamforce, tied to a stuck login service, warning fast AI-driven builds risk stability.
Ravit Jain, host of "The Ravit Show," hypes Dreamforce and Marc Benioff's keynote, sharing a virtual link for those joining remotely.
AI strategist Nadia Hansen jokes about using AI to create her own selfie with Marc Benioff and Dario Amodei at Dreamforce.
Ravit Jain, host of The Ravit Show, previews Dreamforce's Marc Benioff keynote, 1,600 breakout sessions, speakers Allie K. Miller and Anton Osika, and Dreamfest with Usher and Gwen Stefani.
Sonam Malhotra jokes that Einstein AI, Agentforce and ClaudeForce compete as rival generations, noting a year in AI equals three generations.
Salesforce EMEA SMB EVP Giovanni Crispino previews his Dreamforce SMB keynote with Fundamental CEO Jeremy Fraenkel and directs viewers to Salesforce+ for online access.
Guillermo Flor claims Benioff appeared confident onstage with Altman, arguing Salesforce leverages 150,000+ enterprise customers rather than competing on AI models.
Cybersecurity creator Jasmine Wong logs an hour-by-hour Dreamforce Day 1, covering the keynote, Slack Code demo, Security keynote on Salesforce Guardian, and creator meetups.

Salesforce EMEA North EVP Bob Vanstraelen recaps the keynote: AIforce, Koa reasoning model on NVIDIA Nemotron, new Agentforce agents (Hunter, Piper, Casey, Paige, Marshall, Fin), and Adecco's 20,000 placements.
R. Stefan Deeran jokes that Marc Benioff 'framemogged' rival tech CEOs at Dreamforce, calling on short tech leaders to 'rise up.'
Sales executive Chris Barangan announces his return to Salesforce after 11 years to lead the Commercial NGO team on the West Coast, and says he is hiring Account Executives.
